fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami’s tight credit and criticism of local bankers; delays affecting boatbuilding and payrolls tied to rail freight and lumber delivery; discussion of a new comprehensive “Greater Miami Harbor Plan” involving Biscayne Bay, Miami Beach, Terminal Island, and Virginia Key; notes on slot machines and policing; civic items on post office site selection, courthouse washroom access, traffic hazards near the Miami Avenue bridge, and hurricane warning visibility. Also includes society/gossip columns, local business notes (including dairy distribution consolidation and milk costs), and assorted advertisements.
